original_ai_output.title_zh: 索科托州承诺加强安全伙伴关系
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚索科托州政府重申将加强安全伙伴关系、推动防务创新并采用现代技术，以应对该州及西北部地区的安全挑战。州长安全事务特别顾问艾哈迈德·乌斯曼上校（退役）在拉各斯Eko Atlantic举行的2026年非洲国际防务展上代表州长艾哈迈德·阿利尤发表上述表态。他提到恐怖主义、匪盗、跨国有组织犯罪等威胁需要政府、安全机构、防务制造商和技术提供商加强合作。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 索科托州政府重申致力于加强安全伙伴关系并采用现代技术应对不安全问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Sokoto State Government has reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening security partnerships, promoting defence innovation and adopting modern technologies to tackle security challenges in the state and the wider North-West region.

key_facts.fact: 州长安全事务特别顾问乌斯曼代表州长出席在拉各斯Eko Atlantic举行的2026年非洲国际防务展开幕式
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Governor’s Special Adviser on Security Matters, Col. Ahmed Usman (retd.), stated this while representing Governor Ahmed Aliyu at the opening ceremony of the Africa International Defence Exhibition 2026, held at Eko Atlantic, Lagos.

key_facts.fact: 乌斯曼称恐怖主义、匪盗和跨国有组织犯罪等威胁需要各方加强合作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the growing threats of terrorism, banditry, transnational organised crime and other emerging security challenges required stronger collaboration among governments, security agencies, defence manufacturers and technology providers.

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未说明具体安全事件或措施细节
